tutorial.label: TACTICAL TUTORIAL
tutorial.follow_step: COMPLETE THE CURRENT TUTORIAL STEP FIRST
tutorial.briefing.title: DEFEND THE BASE. DESTROY THE NEST.
tutorial.briefing.body: The central core is your base. The pink nest spawns enemies. You lose if the base falls; clear the nest and every enemy to win.
tutorial.resources.title: COINS AND POWER
tutorial.resources.body: Deployment costs coins. Most buildings also need power and go offline without it. Use System Menu to pause and review at any time.
tutorial.energy.title: ENERGY BUILDINGS
tutorial.energy.body: Meet all four energy buildings. You only need to deploy the generator here; the others can be researched in normal operations.
tutorial.deploy_generator.title: DRAG TO DEPLOY: GENERATOR
tutorial.deploy_generator.body: Hold the Generator card, follow the guide, and release over the highlighted tile. Green is valid and red is invalid. Drag back to the bottom bar to cancel.
tutorial.power_result.title: POWER ONLINE
tutorial.power_result.body: The Generator supplies 4 power and the resource display has updated. Next, deploy a turret that consumes power.
tutorial.firepower.title: FIREPOWER BUILDINGS
tutorial.firepower.body: These buildings target enemies automatically. Their range appears during deployment. Compare damage, fire rate, range, and power use.
tutorial.deploy_turret.title: DRAG TO DEPLOY: TURRET
tutorial.deploy_turret.body: Hold the Turret card and drag it to the highlighted tile. Releasing spends 30 coins. The orange area is its range; the Generator powers it.
tutorial.fortification.title: FORTIFICATION BUILDINGS
tutorial.fortification.body: Walls intercept enemies; Amplifiers boost firepower. Their two-tile auras link with other Amplifiers and multiply the shared bonus.
tutorial.deploy_wall.title: DRAG TO DEPLOY: WALL
tutorial.deploy_wall.body: Drag a Wall to the highlighted tile between the base and nest. Walls need no power, absorb attacks, and connect to adjacent walls.
tutorial.ready.title: DEFENSE READY
tutorial.ready.body: You have deployed power, firepower, and interception. Buildings operate automatically once the drill starts. Clear the nest and all enemies to finish.
tutorial.battle.title: DRILL: CLEAR THE NEST
tutorial.battle.body: The Turret attacks targets in range and the Wall intercepts enemies approaching the base. You can still deploy basic buildings.
tutorial.complete.title: TUTORIAL COMPLETE
tutorial.complete.detail: You now know building categories, power supply, and drag deployment. Return to the menu and start an operation.
